info.name: Aldea Campaign Setting Feats
info.description: Feats available in the Aldea Campaign Setting.
info.author: "The Shredder"

description.p: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+, Dexterity 13+, Proficiency with Slings)
Ability Score Increase. Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Sling Master. You gain proficiency with war slings. Additionally, when you deal damage to a creature with a sling weapon, double the number of damage dice rolled.

Ricochet. If you hit a creature with a sling and can use its Mastery property, you can choose to use the Cleave mastery instead, making a ranged attack against a creature within 5 feet of the original target.
